achievements.name: Descent From Avernus
achievements.desc: Take control of the nautiloid and escape the Hells.

achievements.name: The Plot Thickens
achievements.desc: Leave Act I - for somewhere altogether darker.

achievements.name: The City Awaits
achievements.desc: Leave Act II - Baldur's Gate is just over the horizon.

achievements.name: All's Well That Ends Well
achievements.desc: Finish the game (with a heartfelt 'thank you!' from Larian Studios).

achievements.name: Absolute Power Corrupts
achievements.desc: Reign with terror: take control of the Netherbrain and bend the world to your will.

achievements.name: Hero of the Forgotten Realms
achievements.desc: Save the realms: destroy the Absolute once and for all.

achievements.name: Sins of the Father
achievements.desc: Claim your Throne of Blood: take control of the Netherbrain for Bhaal and break the world.

achievements.name: Ceremorphosis
achievements.desc: Make the ultimate sacrifice: become a mind flayer to defeat the Netherbrain.

achievements.name: Roleplayer
achievements.desc: Complete ten background goals in a single playthrough - you are one with your character.

achievements.name: Bedrolls and Breakfast
achievements.desc: Take four full Long Rests in a single playthrough - adventuring's tiring work.

achievements.name: Expand Your Mind
achievements.desc: Consume a parasite and unlock a new power - is it meant to wriggle the whole way down?

achievements.name: Dig for Victory
achievements.desc: Dig up five buried chests in a single playthrough - treasure!

achievements.name: No Penny Required
achievements.desc: Successfully use Detect Thoughts to pry into someone's thoughts.

achievements.name: Escapologist
achievements.desc: Break out of prison after being arrested - aren't you daring?

achievements.name: Outsourcing
achievements.desc: Recruit a hireling. You can befriend them or use them as cannon-fodder - we won't judge.

achievements.name: Jack-of-all-Trades
achievements.desc: Multiclass into every class in one playthrough without asking Withers to change your character.

achievements.name: Homebrewer
achievements.desc: Create three unique alchemical solutions in a single playthrough - bottoms up!

achievements.name: You Have Two Hands for a Reason
achievements.desc: Pet Scratch and the owlbear cub at the same time - the greatest joy an adventurer could ask for.

achievements.name: Rude, Crude, and Full of Attitude
achievements.desc: Find and summon the quasit Shovel. Or is her name... Fork? Maybe Basket?

achievements.name: Forged in Blood and Fire
achievements.desc: Craft an item in the Adamantine Forge.

achievements.name: Under Lock and Key
achievements.desc: Rescue all the prisoners from the depths of Moonrise Towers in one playthrough.

achievements.name: She Cannot Be Caged!
achievements.desc: Rescue Sazza from the Emerald Grove, Goblin Camp, and Moonrise Towers in one playthrough.

achievements.name: Taking Blood
achievements.desc: Steal the Blood of Lathander from underneath Rosymorn Monastery.

achievements.name: Leave No One Behind
achievements.desc: Save every tiefling refugee you can throughout the game in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Murder in Baldur's Gate
achievements.desc: Coat the streets of Baldur's Gate in blood - become an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.

achievements.name: Mind Blown
achievements.desc: Romance the Emperor.

achievements.name: Kill Two Birds With One Gnome
achievements.desc: Use one enemy as an improvised weapon against another.

achievements.name: Busker
achievements.desc: Earn a hundred gold from playing sweet, sweet music in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Action Surge
achievements.desc: Perform five attacks in one turn. Your enemies won't know what hit them (literally).

achievements.name: Fists of Fury
achievements.desc: Kill a character with an Unarmed Strike.

achievements.name: Devil's in the Details
achievements.desc: Defeat Commander Zhalk on the nautiloid.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.desc: Kill the Spider Matriarch before her eggs hatch - why do they have so many legs?

achievements.name: A Grym Fate
achievements.desc: Kill the Adamantine Golem without using the Forge Hammer.

achievements.name: Non-Invasive Procedure
achievements.desc: Kill the Surgeon before he performs surgery on you in combat.

achievements.name: Penny Pincher
achievements.desc: Defeat the Toll Collector without her using gold against you - excellent budgeting.

achievements.name: No Free Lunches
achievements.desc: Defeat the Apostle of Myrkul before it consumes any necromites.

achievements.name: Fancy Footwork
achievements.desc: Defeat Gortash in Wyrm's Rock without activating any traps.

achievements.name: First Blood
achievements.desc: Kill Orin while her cultists are performing their ritual chant.

achievements.name: Interfectorem Draconis
achievements.desc: Kill the red dragon in the Upper City.

achievements.name: Crash Landing
achievements.desc: In the Wyrmway, wait until the dragon is mid-flight, then knock it out of the sky - KAPOW.

achievements.name: Bottoms Up
achievements.desc: Long Rest using only alcohol - a time-honoured dwarven tradition.

achievements.name: Shove Off
achievements.desc: Kill a creature with falling damage.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.desc: Read 100 different books in a single playthrough. Adventuring isn't just daring quests, you know.

achievements.name: Punch Drunk
achievements.desc: Defeat twenty opponents while drunk - down them.

achievements.name: Fetch Quest
achievements.desc: Play fetch with Scratch - the best boy in the Realms.

achievements.name: Repairing the Weave
achievements.desc: Stabilise Gale's Netherese orb.

achievements.name: The Lich-Queen's Wrath
achievements.desc: Ally with Voss against the githyanki God-Queen. Good luck.

achievements.name: To Bloom in Darkest Night
achievements.desc: Gift Shadowheart a night orchid - her favourite flower. Always knew she was a softie.

achievements.name: Hot Date
achievements.desc: Go on a date with Karlach - now that's playing with fire.

achievements.name: Just a Nibble
achievements.desc: Let Astarion bite you at night - ouch.

achievements.name: Loophole
achievements.desc: Break Wyll's pact with Mizora.

achievements.name: Embrace Your Urge
achievements.desc: Become Bhaal's ultimate weapon - become his Slayer.

achievements.name: Critical Hit
achievements.desc: Complete the game in Tactician mode.

achievements.name: Foehammer
achievements.desc: Complete the game in Honour mode.
